text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick update for tomorrow's orientation — 11:00 AM PT / 7:00 PM GMT. Added Zoom link and pre-reads to the calendar invite. Recording will be available.
Tara: Thanks Sam. Can you confirm Zoom not Google Meet? My calendar auto-adds Meet links sometimes.
Sam (People Ops): Zoom using company account. Link in the invite is https://zoom.us/j/5555551212.
Ben: I'm in JST and it's late for me. Will there be a separate APAC-friendly live session or just the recording?
Sam (People Ops): We're scheduling an APAC-friendly live repeat next Thursday at 6:00 AM PT / 11:00 PM JST. I'll create a second invite labelled "APAC-friendly orientation".
Akiko: Perfect. Also can the recording have captions or a transcript? My connection lags and captions help a lot.
Sam (People Ops): We'll enable Zoom auto-captions and upload a clean transcript with timestamps to Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding-pre-reads
IT-bot: Reminder: please complete SSO + MFA before orientation. Access issues will slow you down. Setup guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/mfa
Tara: Could you add onboarding buddy names and emails to the calendar description? Makes follow-ups easier.
Sam (People Ops): Yup — adding buddy assignments and the Slack handles into the event description now.
Ben: Any chance the recording can be split into short clips (setup, benefits, security)? Saves rewatch time.
Sam (People Ops): We'll add timestamps in the Notion page and include jump links in the calendar description.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "New Hire Orientation — Cohort Feb" on 2025-02-12 11:00:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/5555551212. Recording will be posted to https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings. Invite: new-hires@redwood.com
Tara: If someone wants an .ics for a different calendar client, can we get one attached? My manager asked.
IT-bot: Reply with `ics me` in this thread and I'll DM you the file.
Sam (People Ops): I'll post the APAC invite link here when it's up. If you don't get either invite, DM me and I'll send a direct calendar event in your local TZ.
Ben: Thanks — saved me from timezone math :sweat_smile:
Sam (People Ops): Reminder email will go out 90 minutes before the start with the checklist and links. See you tomorrow (or at the APAC session)!
